cannon.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE static raster game asset for a medieval pixel-art fortress defense game. STYLE: clearly visible coarse square pixel clusters, hard pixel edges, restrained muted palette, 3-4 shades per material, no smooth painted gradients, no blur, no glow, no text or labels, no UI, no watermark. Original design. Warm grey stone, weathered brown wood, dark iron; compatible with compact chibi pixel soldiers. Low oblique camera view with some upper surface visible, not steep isometric. Full asset unclipped with clear transparent margin, no cast shadow outside object.
Primary request: Single static medieval black iron cannon on a sturdy weathered wooden carriage with two visible wooden wheels. REAR THREE QUARTER VIEW from behind defenders: breech near viewer, barrel points AWAY toward top of image and slightly left, aimed toward approaching enemies beyond wall. Entire cannon and both wheels. Compact simple readable silhouette. No people, no ammunition, no terrain.

Tile has NO outer border, NO transparent margin, NO isometric diamond, NO raised slab edges, NO bushes or cliffs. Aim seamless repeatable edges but final tiling will be reviewed.
